items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Bud was always there. He was always hanging out there, whether he was invited there or not he was always hanging out with his buddies. Jimmy and he were very close. And I got into the fold that way.

ctx.x: And then that whole band went to England, was invited to England to do a tour. So then they got Jimmy McPartland in there, Pee Wee Russell, Vic Dickinson, Buzzy and I went on piano and drums, and that’s when we had Walter Page on bass. And they were away for about two months so we had a ball playing there, and of course on Tuesday evenings it was guest night. And they’d bring people like Bobby Hackett in or Billy Butterfield or Bud Freedman. Bud was always there. He was always hanging out there, whether he was…
What would happen on a gig like that if someone called a tune and you didn’t know it?
